'''Imperial credit''' was the main currency of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] used on worlds controlled of the Empire and by citizens and personnel of the Empire.

==History==
In [[3950 BBY]] [[Meetra Surik]] came to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in search of her former mentor [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. She went to [[Larvit's store]] to convert her [[Diamond/Legends|diamonds]] into the local currency.<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial credit of the Sith Empire first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', which was published on [[November 15]], [[2011]]. The Imperial credit later appeared in the [[BioWare]]'s video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released on [[December 20]], 2011.
